relation: H (1 + 4 Ne u) = 4 Ne u, i.e. H = theta/(1 + theta) with theta = 4 Ne u  (infinite-alleles equilibrium)
note: Checks that a committed neutral heterozygosity is the mutation-drift equilibrium of the committed effective size and mutation rate. The law also proves 0 < H < 1 follows, so a committed H outside (0,1) is impossible under the hypothesis. 'violated' means the three numbers cannot hold together at equilibrium; it does NOT mean the population is mismeasured, because real populations are routinely away from this equilibrium and observed diversity varies far less across species than Ne predicts (Lewontin's paradox).
